what: Full-board gray clouds — a texture of five-layer fbm warped twice by fbm (coords ×1.4, warp 1.8 and 2.0) swirls slowly at time ×.06, and the value is restretched to .12~.95 and painted between the background color and the text color. Where the cursor passes, its velocity ×2600 is written into a 40×40 flow grid (decaying .08 per frame) and pushes the cloud coords by .25, and strongly flowing areas break into 5px chunks (OGL·WebGL)

options.zoom: Noise coordinate scale (larger : finer and denser), default 1
options.displace: Amount the flow pushes the clouds, default .25
options.block: Side length of each breaking chunk (px), default 5
options.pixel: Flow strength → chunk share multiplier, default 15
options.time: Start time in seconds — makes each round start differently, default 0
options.trail: When off, the cursor flow is disabled (only the self-driven ripple remains)

from.where: index.html .sg-noise below the hero · service.html One cloud panel

note: The original solutions panel also pushes the clouds with a wake (64×64 viscous flow field) left by a brand mark flying over them, but that belongs to the mark flight scene, so it is not included in this part. With reduced motion it is one still frame, and on touch devices it only ripples without the flow
